Delhi University Admissions and Surveys Set to Begin

Delhi University is preparing for undergraduate admissions, which are expected to commence within the next week. Concurrently, a survey is scheduled to begin in Delhi next week. These developments indicate upcoming academic and potentially administrative activities in the capital.
